title: Ai2 releases Olmo-core 3 for scaling open mixture-of-experts training
friendlyTitle: Ai2 opens faster software for training very large AI models
summary: Ai2 has released Olmo-core 3, an open training stack designed to scale mixture-of-experts models into the trillion-parameter range. In a preliminary eight-GPU test, its redesigned distributed system delivered about 2.7 times the throughput of the earlier implementation for a 47-billion-parameter model.
friendlySummary: Olmo-core 3 helps researchers train mixture-of-experts models, which use only part of a large model for each piece of text.
whyItMatters: Open training infrastructure gives researchers and smaller labs more visibility into how large sparse models are built and optimized. The practical gain is not a new chatbot today, but a more inspectable route to efficient models tomorrow.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Open tools can make advanced AI research easier to inspect, test and improve outside the biggest companies.
